simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דְּוַי (H1741) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דְּוַי (dᵉvay) means sickness ; figuratively, loathing First listed occurrence: Job 6 7.

definitions.full: H1741. devay דְּוַי noun [masculine] illness , דְּוָי֑ עֶרֶשׂ Psa 41:4 bed of languishing (Che); singular construct (Ew De Di) לַחְמִי כִּדְוֵי הֵמָּה Job 6:7 they (i.e. my sufferings) are like disease (VB loathsomeness ) in my meat , compare Di; but text dubious
